ratings.reason: MintEval measures silent behavioral divergence in LLM-generated trading-strategy code (79.2% of correctly-read specs diverge on >10% of bars), a model-side code-correctness issue outside the areas' hardware/infra reliability scope.

Zephon provides elastic determinism for online stateful data loading across GPU topology changes and checkpoint-resume cycles, so ablation differences are attributable to the changed parameter rather than data-sequence nondeterminism.

Introduces branch steering attacks that coerce computer-use agents down hazardous pre-approved branches (94.4% ASR) and COBRA's capability-constrained trusted branching cuts ASR to 0% at 97% benign utility — trustworthiness of autonomous agents.

ULTRADISCOVERY isolates abductive exploration — revising a taught theory and predicting cross-domain interventions — and finds no agent composes evidence into a transferable representation within 200 actions, directly probing agentic scientific discovery.

LS-AR decouples goal steering from token decoding via FiLM-conditioned latent channels (Static Goal Encoder + Dynamic State Tracker), showing latent-dominant control that resists prompt injection but opens a latent attack surface.

Maps post-softmax attention into a token-head marginal attention space across 60+ models, connects it theoretically to the input-output Jacobian, and finds a text-intrinsic conserved signal plus a model-private per-head signature.

Targeted single-event-upset (bit-flip) fault-injection campaigns across iterative structured-pruning stages show pruning's higher per-inference fault sensitivity is offset by shorter exposure time, directly quantifying SEU reliability under model compression.

Online conformal calibration restores coverage control for RL-driven NAS pruning, but the contribution is NAS evaluation-cost reduction with statistical guarantees, not training/inference precision or reliability.
A retrieval benchmark for Dictyostelium biology literature (reranking, gene-aware query expansion, full-text chunks) has no connection to any listed area.

EvoRiskBench executes 450 adversarial tasks against nine model-harness configurations (Codex with DeepSeek-V4-Pro reaches 68.44% ASR), measuring runtime security of workspace agents that access and modify external resources.

Linear probes decode simulator-derived physical quantities from video-DiT activations early in denoising, showing information is computed globally but stored locally at on-object tokens and can act as steering vectors.

ImmuneAgent is a closed-loop system combining multimodal reasoning, continual meta-learning, and wet-lab feedback that discovers broadly neutralizing antibodies (55% discovery rate), instantiating automated experimentation with real-world feedback.

Contrastive activation steering and a hypernetwork predicting steering vectors/LoRA adapters for author style, with the finding that manually extracted and predicted steering directions are near-orthogonal yet score comparably.

Explains on-policy distillation collapse into overlong repetitive generation as reward hacking of the teacher's implicit reward, and shows masking unhealthy responses or SFT initialization mitigates the divergence.
Teaches LLM investigators when evidence suffices to close a case (overstatement falls 97% to 35%), addressing calibrated evidence-gathering decisions of autonomous investigative agents.
Documents source preference bias in LLM agent item selection and mitigations — a behavioral-fairness phenomenon with no tie to agent reliability mechanisms or the other areas.
Task-vector variance across specialists predicts merge collapse and PRISM repairs it, but the analysis is weight-space statistics rather than hidden-state or activation-level interpretability.

Trains small language models as per-call task-tool relevance classifiers (prompt optimization, SFT, GRPO) to verify every agent tool call against task intent — runtime oversight for trustworthy autonomous execution.

AdaStep derives an optimal shrinkage coefficient for step-level credit in agentic RL — a generic post-training algorithm with no self-evolution, reliability, or interpretability angle.

Characterizes when numerical execution paths (draft-free target-only vs speculative decoding) change greedy outputs on consumer GPUs and quantifies realized costs of direct-ID qualification and serialization.

Shows request-form experience shapes the pre-answer context state, and causal interventions on this hidden state can enable or prevent retrieval of already-learned facts, transferring across factual relations.

Proves finite-time training-loss guarantees for Muon with tuned finite-step Newton-Schulz orthogonalization — optimizer convergence theory, not run monitoring or anomaly detection.
